full_judgment:
Mohammad Abdur Rouf  J: Respondent No. 1, Md Fazlur Rahman claiming himself as the founder-life member and Secretary of Adarsha Prathomik Biddaloya, situated at the WAPDA Road, Pashchim Rampura, Dhaka lodged a petition of complaint in the Court of the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, against the petitioner and two teachers of the said school alleging, inter alia, that those two teachers in violation of School Rules and Regulations did not deposit the tuition-fees and other charges that they had realised from the students, into bank account of the school and thereby during the period from July to November 1993 the accused persons misappropriated about Taka 70,000.00. CR No. 152 of 1994, under sections 408/34 of the Penal Code was started against the petitioner and the aforesaid two others. After examination of the complainant under section 200 Code of Criminal Procedure the case was sent for enquiry. On the basis of the enquiry report dated 11-2-94, made by Mr Debashish Chowdhury, SI of Police, Gulshan Police Station, the Metropolitan Magistrate Mr Anisuzzaman on 19-9-94 charged the accused persons including the petitioner under sections 408/34 of the Penal Code. 

 2. The present petitioner then moved the High Court Division under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the proceeding and obtained a Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1016 of 1995. It was stated therein that the petitioner had no connection with the realisation of money from the students of the school and that he is neither an employee nor a teacher of the said school and, as such, making him an accused in the instant case is malafide. A Division Bench of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order dated 14-1-96 discharged the Rule holding, inter alia, that there are allegations in the petition of complaint that all the accused persons have misappropriated the school money. The petitioner is now seeking leave to appeal from the said judgment of the High Court Division.
